verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a game engine editor, so the axis applies, but no evidence pack item documents one in Unreal Editor. The Neural Network Engine is a developer building block for running neural-network inference, not an assistant users can delegate tasks to. Python scripting and the Remote Control API are automation primitives, not an AI assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
